title: ID0464019-DC/Si-D/FI-[Y2 / R6 313099394009] Wrong LEM meter values
description:
Reported behavior/issue: LEM meter values don't match the Voltage transducer
Workaround: Remove LEM address
Solution: Replace VP and VN cables from LEM to busbar

additional_info.subject: Additional Notes
additional_info.body: Customer complaining that site lifetime consumed energy doesnt match with charger. We find out that DC1 OCPP voltage value is too low and due to that voltage*current=Wh is much lower.

additional_info.subject: ID0464019-DC/Si-D/FL-[Y2 / R6 313099394009] OCPP Energy Fault CRM:02888000435
additional_info.body:
Hi Markus, good afternoon.
As we agreed last time, please check with the customer what is the most feasible option here. My suggestion is to remove the LEM address and do a charging session without OCPP in order to avoid constraints for the customer.
Let me know what you prefer to do here or if we should prepare any plan.
Thanks!
BR,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: ID0464019-DC/Si-D/FL-[Y2 / R6 313099394009] OCPP Energy Fault CRM:02888000435
additional_info.body:
Hi Markus, good morning.
I think we have an agreement of what to do next, if the removal works, then it means that the sensor of the LEM might not be ok and need replacement.
Please let me know what you want to do, since there is nothing to do from my side, I should send to RC-FI queue.
Thanks!
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0464019-DC/Si-D/FL-[Y2 / R6 313099394009] OCPP Energy Fault CRM:02888000435

After LEM IP was removed, voltage value started to match.
Markus

From our side, it's not feasible to deliver this spare parts as it doesn't make sense. It can be bought locally.
So the idea is that for the cables between busbar and LEM are this size and color:
And the Screw for the busbar is a 10mm which needs a ring as well. For the side of the LEM as far as I understood it's just to fit the cable with a ferrule.
Let me know if this is what you need and if you have questions or doubts, just reach out to me.
Thanks!
BR,
Francisco
